readme: README 5.2 (ROB-01~04), 6.1 (metrics, change rate, paired bootstrap), 4.2 (threshold, FP32 eval, batch, dynamic padding, max length); spec-stage3 Evaluation; written by scripts/eval_cases.py

rules.bootstrap: groups = group_id, merged within each comparison when texts share build_lists.nk (merged id = smallest group_id), strata = proposed label (mixed if several), groups sorted, strata sorted, numpy default_rng(314159) restarted per comparison, integers(0, n_s, (2000, n_s)) per stratum; per resample the ratio of summed counts per seed, 3-seed mean, then B - A; numpy.percentile 2.5 / 97.5 (linear); null CI when any resample is undefined
rules.cases: status assigned with review decision keep or relabel (label = new_label); pending or exclude (not yet replaced by build_dev_cases.py --apply-review) refused unless --allow-incomplete, which leaves them out (a ROB-01 exclude takes the whole original out)
rules.change_rate: pairs (case, original) with different predictions / pairs, per seed; label slice = the original label
rules.config: configs/train.json SHA-256 (LF) equal to the stage-2 record before any setting is read
rules.metrics: eval_lib.metrics; label all only with both labels (F1, precision, recall, FPR, ROC-AUC on the margin), 1: recall, 0: FPR; N/A is null
rules.models: nine stage-2 runs; checkpoint SHA-256 and selected step pinned from results/s2/runs.csv, run files' SHA-256 from results/s2/summary.json; eval_lib.load_run_model
rules.numbers: non-integers rounded to 6 decimals, except max_abs_margin_diff_9_digits
rules.originals: all validation rows predicted in sentence-ID order (eval batch), predictions equal to predictions_validation.csv at the selected step (else refused)
rules.rob03: position from cases.csv; length long when a context side has more than 42 whitespace words, else short
rules.seeds: mean and sample std (n - 1) over the seeds; null when any seed is N/A
